en: Xiaolongnu: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Ancient Tomb.
Xiaolongnu: Would you like to join?
Wu Jieshan: Tiger skins are getting harder and harder to come by. How about it - fancy collecting some for me?
I'll help you
Wu Jieshan: Much obliged! The tigers are in Flower Vale. One Tiger Skin will do.
Wu Jieshan: Ha ha, you're back at last! Nice work - you don't waste any time.
The rains have been good this year. We should have a fine harvest.
Beggar: This is intelligence from Dali. Please get it to the Elder at once.
Our cloth shop's goods are top quality and cheap too.
A few days ago traveling merchants were trading here. What a lively scene it was!
Dali is so sunny and lovely. Who wouldn't long for a life like this?
Swords for sale! Swords for sale! A family heirloom!
May I take a look at your sword?
Go ahead.
Hm! Sure enough, it's engraved with the words "Lord Yue". This must be Yue Fei's Sword.
How much for the sword? I'll buy it.
Twenty thousand taels, and only in 2000-tael banknotes. Not a copper less.
Buy
Don't buy
Paid 20,000 taels in banknotes
Got Yue Fei's Sword
I said not a copper less, and you're short. Whatever you've handed over counts as interest.
Dali is big, but orderly. That's what made me move here for good.
Dali has dedicated guards to protect us, so we all live in peace.
There's lots to do in Dali, and it's easy to get around. What a great place.
Tongren Hall, Dali branch: the finest medicines for you.
As the saying goes: save one life, and you earn merit for ten thousand generations.
Young one, you seem to be of good character. I'll teach you some Basic Heal. Would you like to learn?

This is the Dali branch of the Fuwei Escort Agency. We're swamped lately, and a shipment has to reach the general store in the Capital in a hurry. You look like you can handle yourself, hero. Deliver it for us and this 500-tael fee is yours.

I hear someone from our country has opened an underground casino in Yangzhou. I'm busy chasing a fugitive murderer and have no time to go there. Could you look into this person for me? I'll reward you well when you return!
Old Mr. Wang: Young one, my illness has flared up again. Could you fetch me a medicine called Jade Salve from the pharmacy? Otherwise I fear this old life of mine is done for.
Help him
Old Mr. Wang: Thank you! Young one, my life is in your hands.
Old Mr. Wang: Mm... young one, I'm truly grateful! Here are 120 taels for the medicine. Sorry to run you about - have a cup of water before you go!
Excuse me, are you Zhang Jing?
Zhang Jing: I am! And who might you be?
I'm a friend of your son's. He's been away from home so long that he asked me to come and see how you are. He also asked me to bring you a letter.
Zhang Jing: So Ah Hong sent you to see me. Thank you for coming all this way. Wait a moment while I read the letter.
Of course. Go ahead.
Zhang Jing: So my Ah Hong is homesick. Please tell him all is well at home and he needn't worry. Here's my letter to him - would you take it to him for me?
Yes, Auntie, I'll see that he gets it.
Thank you so much for your trouble!
Qiu Qianren, the Seven Freaks, Lu Chengfeng, Huang Rong and Guo Jing are deep in discussion.
Qiu Qianren: I've come in the hope that you'll all submit to the Great Jin and abandon the Song, and spare the people a bloodbath.
Seven Freaks: Hmph! You Jin dog!
After a fierce fight, Qiu Qianren claims he needs the privy and slips away. Then Cyclone Mei arrives, and the moment she sees Guo Jing she pounces on him.
Someone with superb lightness skill carries Cyclone Mei off. Huang Rong leaves for Peach Blossom Island.

Wang Chongyang: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Quanzhen Sect.
Wang Chongyang: Would you like to join?
Show mercy where you can, and good things will come back to you.
There's a boat to Peach Blossom Island from the pier outside town.
Food is heaven to the people. Rich soil grows more rice and grain.
Yangzhou is so big! If I'm not careful I'll get lost for sure.
There's lots to do in Yangzhou, and it's easy to get around. What a great place.
Yangzhou is a great place! It gets more prosperous every day.
Yangzhou has dedicated guards to protect us, so we all live in peace.
Word is Yue Fei's Sword has turned up in the martial world again. Someone saw it on the streets of Dali.
Innkeeper, I'd like some Huiquan wine, Jinling Spring, Hundred Flower brew, Jade Blossom dew and Shuanggou Daqu.
Here's your order, please take care of it! That comes to 100 taels.
Tongren Hall, Yangzhou branch: the finest medicines for you.
Young one, you seem to have real talent. I'll teach you some Basic Qi. Would you like to learn?

This is the Yangzhou branch of the Fuwei Escort Agency. We're swamped lately, and a shipment has to reach the general store in Xixia in a hurry. You look like you can handle yourself, hero. Deliver it for us and this 500-tael fee is yours.

I hear someone from our country has opened an underground casino in Xixia. I'm busy chasing a fugitive murderer and have no time to go there. Could you look into this person for me? I'll reward you well when you return!
Brother! What are you doing here?
Lao Denuo: Master gave me some business to see to. What brings you here?
Oh, Master sent me to find a distant relative of Brother Lin's.
Suddenly some men from the Songshan Sect burst in.
Songshan Disciple: Brother... Sorry, wrong door.
The Songshan Sect men hurry off again.
Ha! Those fools start shouting before they even see who's here. Pretty stupid, eh, Brother?
Lao Denuo: Y-yes... yes, very stupid. Very stupid indeed.
Well, I'll go and find Brother Lin's relative. Let's talk another time.
Lao Denuo: Oh, yes, yes, of course. Another time, another time. (Lao Denuo looks nervous.)
Lao Denuo! So you're a spy for the Songshan Sect! Hand over the Violet Mist Manual - Master and I know everything. Give it up and I'll spare your life. Now!
Lao Denuo: So you both know. Yes, I have it. But can you beat me? Hahaha!
Lao Denuo: Aaargh!...
A poisoned arrow flies out of the shadows. Lao Denuo falls dead.
Those swine! Killing him to shut him up. Hmph! Let's see if the manual is on him.
Found the real Violet Mist Manual
I shouldn't linger here. Better go back and wait for Master.
Ah Hong: Sigh...
What are you sighing about?
Ah Hong: I left home a year ago, and I miss my mother.
Oh... you're homesick. Then go home and see her! A grown man sitting here sighing - it's not a good look!
I can't go back, I have work to do. Could you go and see my mother for me?
I'll help
Ah Hong: Thank you so much! Please take this letter home for me.
Ah Hong: My home is in Dali, and my mother's name is Zhang Jing. Please give her this letter.
Don't worry! I'll make sure she gets it.
Ah Hong: I've been waiting ages for you. Did you see my mother?
Everything at home is fine. Your mother asked me to tell you not to worry about them, and she sent this letter for you.
Thank you so much for your help! Please take this money as a small token of thanks.
Well... all right, I'll take it.
Squire Li: I'm very interested in high-quality ore. If you have any, sell it to me. I pay 500 for Plat Ore and 1000 for Gold Ore.
Squire Li: So where's your ore?
Ke Zhen'e: Your voice tells me you are no ordinary person. May I ask who you are?
I'm nobody of note. Beyond the pass I rescued a young lady, and she asked me to call on Master Ke.
Ke Zhen'e: Ah, so you're the one who saved Miss Huazheng's life. My respects.
Ke Zhen'e: In a couple of days we Seven Freaks are going to see how that boy Guo Jing's kung fu is coming along. Come with us, if you like.
Then I'll gladly accept.
The Freaks have gone beyond the pass
